meta.description: SWE-bench style evaluation set for TensorPlatform fleet capability baseline. 20 tasks extracted from historical missions (m186-m325), 10 succeeded + 10 failed, covering 5 repos. Acceptance criteria are independent of original author self-tests.

difficulty_levels.easy: Single-file fix, clear error message, <50 LOC change
difficulty_levels.medium: Multi-file change, requires understanding of module interfaces, 50-200 LOC
difficulty_levels.hard: Cross-module or cross-repo change, requires domain knowledge, >200 LOC or numerical validation

meta.conflict_of_interest_check: No task was authored by any evaluated model's operator session

tasks.title: MP-DAMBREAK:S2 — 3D dam-break convergence staircase
tasks.description: Implement a 3D dam-break validation case with mesh convergence study (3 resolutions). The case should produce water column collapse profiles comparable to experimental data (Martin & Moyce 1952). Requires VOF free-surface tracking, gravity, and no-slip walls. Output: interface position vs time at 3 mesh levels, convergence order.
acceptance_criteria: Case runs to completion on 3 mesh levels (coarse/medium/fine) without crash
Interface position at t=0.1s matches experimental envelope within 15%
Convergence order ≥ 1.0 (first-order minimum for VOF)
Mass conservation error < 2% over full simulation
Input deck documented with Reynolds number, Froude number, mesh stats
solution_hints: Use existing VOF advection scheme in TensorLBM
Initialize with Heaviside step for water column
Use Martin & Moyce dimensionless time t* = t*sqrt(g/L0)
Mesh refinement ratio 2:1, report L1 norm of interface error

tasks.title: TUTORIAL-WAVE:poiseuille_3d_annulus — 3D annular Poiseuille flow tutorial
tasks.description: Create a tutorial case for 3D Poiseuille flow in an annular geometry. The case should demonstrate parabolic velocity profile, compute flow rate, and compare with analytical solution. Target: educational use with step-by-step documentation.
acceptance_criteria: Velocity profile at mid-length matches analytical u(r) = (dp/dx)/(4μ) * (R_o² - r² + (R_i²-R_o²)/ln(R_o/R_i) * ln(r/R_i)) within 3%
Flow rate Q matches analytical within 2%
Reynolds number < 2000 (laminar regime confirmed)
Tutorial includes mesh convergence study (≥3 levels)
Documentation explains boundary conditions and non-dimensionalization
solution_hints: Use periodic BC in streamwise direction with body force
No-slip on inner and outer cylinders
Analytical solution from White Viscous Fluid Flow, Ch.3
Grid: structured O-grid or Cartesian with immersed boundary

tasks.title: BENCH-CLOSE:cylinder-w11a2-harvest — Cylinder benchmark data harvest
tasks.description: Harvest and validate benchmark data for flow past a cylinder at Re=100, W=11, A=2 (width ratio, aspect ratio). Compare drag coefficient Cd, Strouhal number St, and recirculation length Lr with reference data (Schäfer & Turek 1996). Produce a benchmark report with error bars.
acceptance_criteria: Mean Cd within 5% of reference value (Cd_ref ≈ 5.579 for 2D, or 3D correction)
Strouhal number St = f*D/U within 5% of reference (St_ref ≈ 0.264)
Recirculation length Lr/D within 10% of reference
Time-averaged statistics over ≥10 shedding cycles
Mesh independence demonstrated (≥3 resolutions)
solution_hints: Reference: Schäfer & Turek benchmark 2D-1/3D-1
Use spectral/hp or fine Cartesian mesh near cylinder
Time integration: at least 200 convective time units
Report both 2D and 3D results if applicable

tasks.title: TUTORIAL-WAVE:poiseuille_two_phase_cg — Two-phase Poiseuille with CG tracking
tasks.description: Implement a two-phase Poiseuille flow tutorial with continuum surface force (CSF) model and curvature computation via height-function or least-squares. Validate against analytical two-layer Poiseuille solution. Challenge: accurate curvature at low resolution.
acceptance_criteria: Two-layer velocity profile matches analytical within 5% at interface
Spurious currents < 1% of max velocity at equilibrium
Curvature error < 10% on circular interface test
Mass conservation < 1% over 1000 time steps
Tutorial includes parameter study (viscosity ratio, surface tension)
solution_hints: CSF: σκ∇α, κ = -∇·n, n = ∇α/|∇α|
Height-function curvature for structured grids
Analytical: two-layer with μ₁, μ₂, interface at y=h
Use viscous scaling for time step (CFL_v < 0.25)

tasks.title: QUAL-2: Quality gate for DEM bonded-particle calibration

Checks: E_macro within 10%, ν_macro within 10%, σ_c within 10%

tasks.title: TUTORIAL-WAVE:cavity_natural_convection — Natural convection in square cavity
tasks.description: Create a tutorial for natural convection in a differentially heated square cavity (Rayleigh-Bénard type). Validate Nusselt number against benchmark correlations for Ra = 10^3, 10^4, 10^5. Demonstrate Boussinesq approximation implementation.
acceptance_criteria: Average Nu matches De Vahl Davis benchmark within 3% for Ra=10^3,10^4,10^5
Stream function ψ_max matches reference within 5%
Temperature field symmetric about cavity center (for Ra≤10^5)

Tutorial includes grid convergence (≥3 levels) and Ra sweep
solution_hints: Reference: De Vahl Davis (1983) Int. J. Numer. Meth. Fluids
Boussinesq: ρ = ρ₀(1 - β(T-T₀)), body force = -ρg
Boundary: T_hot left, T_cold right, adiabatic top/bottom
Non-dimensionalize: length L, velocity α/L, time L²/α
